title: Friston, Levin, Sengupta & Pezzulo (2015) Variational Free Energy Gradient Flow Across a Markov Blanket for Morphogenetic Pattern Regulation

primary_papers.citation: Friston K, Levin M, Sengupta B, Pezzulo G (2015) Knowing one's place: a free-energy approach to pattern regulation. J. R. Soc. Interface 12(105):20141383

Pezzulo G, Levin M (2015) Re-membering the body: applications of computational neuroscience to the top-down control of regeneration of limbs and other complex organs. J. R. Soc. Interface 12(110):20150772

levin_channel_concept.speaker: Karl Friston & Giovanni Pezzulo
levin_channel_concept.topic: Variational Free Energy Gradient Flow Across a Markov Blanket

governing_equations.markov_blanket_partition: States {eta, s, a, mu} with blanket B={s,a}; conditional independence mu ⊥ eta | B
governing_equations.perception_ode: dmu/dt = kappa_mu * Pi_s * (s - mu) - kappa_mu * Pi_p * (mu - mu_star)

experimental_regimes.description: Scrambled AP morphological field recovers the stored target gradient under intact Markov-blanket active inference (Pi_s>0, g_gj>0)
Setting g_gj=0 abolishes spatial sensory averaging; pattern still recovers but with higher residual spatial roughness
Pi_s=0 abolishes action and perception updates driven by sensory PE; morphology arrests near the scrambled initial state
Rewriting mu_star to a mirrored AP gradient drives regeneration to the new target morphology without genomic change
kappa_mu=0 freezes internal beliefs; action alone cannot correct a mismatched prior, leaving residual free energy
